# Rory Phillips, AI for owner-managed businesses

> Practical AI implementation for UK owner-managed businesses: a free AI readiness assessment, fixed-price audits, team training and a fractional AI officer retainer, with sector pages for construction, manufacturing, clinics, roofing, restaurants, agencies and ecommerce.

Pages describe services and typical outcomes in general terms. No client results are guaranteed.

## Services

- [Rory Phillips: hand-coded websites that load in under a second](https://roryphillips.dev/): Hand-coded websites for small businesses, and fractional AI officer services for established UK companies. Sub-second loads, no templates, automations priced in £/month saved.
- [Fractional AI Officer for UK businesses: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/fractional-ai-officer/): Fractional AI officer for owner-managed UK businesses. I automate quoting, reporting and invoice-chasing, and train your team to run it: priced in £/month saved.
- [AI systems for owner-managed UK businesses: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/services/): I find the manual work inside your business, price it in £/month, and install the systems that remove it. Free readiness check, £3,500 audit, fractional AI officer retainers from £4,500/mo.
- [AI Readiness Audit](https://roryphillips.dev/assessment/)
- [AI field notes: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/ai-notes/): Weekly working notes from helping owner-managed UK businesses put AI to work: automations built, hours saved, honest numbers, and the occasional dead end.
- [Speed Rescue: a real speed-audit sample](https://roryphillips.dev/speed-rescue/): In July 2026 I audited 50+ UK trades websites on mobile. A third scored under 60/100. See the real numbers, a real sample breakdown, and get yours free.
- [Ampere & Sons: Instant Electrical Quote Calculator, Manchester](https://roryphillips.dev/calculator/): Family electricians in Manchester since 1987. Get an instant, itemised estimate for rewires, consumer units, EV chargers and more: no forms, no waiting.
